The 'Obsidian One, $349' caption floats above it, cut off from the headphones. The 'Obsidian Buds, $179' label and the Compare Models CTA sit above the headphones' grey shadow disc, while the buds and their disc are stranded at the bottom, so the product, price and CTA groupings are broken and the CTA is buried mid-canvas.
